rows.label: tlk41100152_01_msg0001
rows.name:
My older brother... his name's Elnoth.
He became a Driver!

rows.label: tlk41100152_01_msg0002
rows.name:
And then he enlisted in
the Superbian army!

rows.label: tlk41100152_01_msg0003
rows.name:
...Huh? But what kind of weapon did
my older brother's Blade have?

rows.label: tlk41100152_01_msg0004
rows.name:
If the weapon is an Axe or Lance, that
Blade should be good at attacking.

rows.label: tlk41100152_01_msg0005
rows.name:
But that Blade has to avoid drawing
attention. Being targeted by everyone
at once would be dangerous.

rows.label: tlk41100152_01_msg0006
rows.name:
If it's a Ball, that means a Blade
that's good at healing injured allies.

rows.label: tlk41100152_01_msg0007
rows.name:
You'd especially need to watch allies
with Hammers or Katanas and keep their
health up.

rows.label: tlk41100152_01_msg0008
rows.name:
I know a lot, right? My older
brother and I studied together!
